best_hook.why: 'For standing between me and those men' - tearful woman in a wrecked garden immediately signals violence just happened and a protector; the strongest opener in a quiet episode.

best_cliffhanger.why: 'I know almost nothing about the man I married' - right after he refuses 'Not yet', it plants the mystery of his true identity and leaves it hanging.

must_promos.why: The vow beat: 'As long as I draw breath... no one will hurt you again' / 'You cannot promise that' / 'I just did' - a swoon-romance cut for female-skewing audiences; ending is more button than cliffhanger.

Fireside intimacy into his guarded 'Not yet' when she reaches for his beard, landing on the voice-over 'I know almost nothing about the man I married' - a soft mystery tease for the secret-duke premise.

standalone_risk: No antagonist and no on-screen danger; a stranger does not see the attack being referenced, and the meaning of 'Not yet' (hiding his identity behind the hair and beard) is only implied.
notes: Transitional romance episode. Neither promo has a real scroll-stopping hook; the first ends on a resolved line ('I just did').
